about: Many older people have few people around them.
quote: While data on social isolation is more limited, it is estimated to affect up to 1 in 3 older adults and 1 in 4 adolescents.
who: World Health Organization, news release on the report of its Commission on Social Connection, 30 June 2025

about: Many families live far apart, so a visit is rare and has to count.
asked: Thinking about all your grandchild(ren), how far (in miles) do you live from your grandchild(ren)?
who: AARP Research, Powering Families: The Essential Role of Grandparents in Care, Connection and Support, annotated questionnaire, June 2026
whom: Grandparents in the United States, age 35 and older, asked in late 2025. They could name more than one distance

about: A grandchild may no longer speak the language a grandparent is most at home in.
quote: Close to two-thirds (65%) of third- or higher-generation Latinos say they cannot carry on a conversation well in Spanish.
who: Pew Research Center, 20 September 2023, from a survey of August 2022
whom: Latino adults in the United States whose parents were also born there
